newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia T-bill yields seen close to market.
newsitem.headline: Russia T-bill yields seen close to market.

text.p: The average yield at an auction of 8.5 trillion roubles of 203-day Russian Treasury bills (series 22062) on Wednesday is likely to be between 35.12 and 40.27 percent, close to the market rate, dealers said on Tuesday.
They said the price on an additional tranche of three trillion roubles of two-year OFZ government bonds (series 24009) maturing July 1998 was likely to be 93.17-95.00 percent.
Some traders said there could be a premium in the T-bill auction over the market yield but others said non-resident interest in the auction would allow the ministry to keep yields low.

"Tomorrow's auction will not be very interesting because it was a lot more profitable to invest yesterday at 40-41 percent than tomorrow at 37. Overnight rates rose this evening so the finance ministry probably will not give a big yield tomorrow," said Alexander Inzhievsky of Alfa-Bank.
Sergei Koshelenko from CS First Boston said approval or otherwise of the 1997 budget would influence domestic and foreign investors.
* The average price of 24009 bond closed at 94 percent
* Average yield of T-bill 22057, with closest maturity to 22062, closed at 38.49 percent
* The average yield fell to 39.1 percent from 40.9 percent
* Volume rose to 6.00 trillion roubles from 4.66 trillion
* Pay interest of 690.90 billion roubles on OFZ bond 24007
* Repay 6.47 trillion roubles of maturing six-month T-bill 22036
* Auction additional tranche of three trillion roubles of OFZ bond 24009
